# # Collateral Management Policy

## 1. Purpose and Scope

### 1.1 Purpose
This Collateral Management Policy outlines the organization's approach to taking and managing collateral for loans and trades. The purpose is to ensure a consistent and risk-appropriate process for collateral evaluation and management.

### 1.2 Scope
This policy applies to all employees involved in the collateral management process, including but not limited to relationship managers, credit analysts, and operations staff. It covers all forms of collateral accepted by the organization, including bonds, stocks, and other asset types.

### 1.3 Effective Date
This Collateral Management Policy is effective as of [DATE].

## 3. Policy Statement

### 3.1 General Principles
All collateral taken by the organization must undergo a thorough evaluation process to ensure it meets our risk and eligibility criteria. Collateral discounts may be applied for riskier asset types as determined by the Collateral Management Desk.

### 3.2 Specific Requirements
- Collateral must be reviewed and approved by the Collateral Management Desk before acceptance
- Legal review may be required for certain collateral types or complex arrangements
- Collateral must be monitored on an ongoing basis to ensure it continues to meet eligibility criteria
- Any exceptions to this policy must be documented and approved by the Head of Credit Risk

## 7. Review and Updates

### 7.1 Review Frequency
This Collateral Management Policy will be reviewed on an annual basis by the Risk Management Committee.

### 7.2 Update Process
Proposed updates to the policy will be presented to the Risk Management Committee for review and approval. Once approved, the updated policy will be communicated to all relevant staff.

### 7.3 Version Control
This is version 1.0 of the Collateral Management Policy, effective as of [DATE].
